title: JAK3 Y841 Autophosphorylation Is Critical for STAT5B Activation, Kinase Domain Stability and Dimer Formation.
authors: Rodriguez, Georgialina; Martinez, George Steven; Negrete, Omar Daniel; Sun, Shengjie; Guo, Wenhan; Xie, Yixin; Li, Lin; Xiao, Chuan; Ross, Jeremy Aaron; Kirken, Robert Arthur
one_liner_zh: 该文研究JAK3激酶自磷酸化位点Y841对STAT5激活和激酶域稳定性的作用，虽含计算生物物理分析，但核心是激酶磷酸化信号传导，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Janus tyrosine kinase 3 (JAK3) is primarily expressed in immune cells and is needed for signaling by the common gamma chain (gammac) family of cytokines. Abnormal JAK3 signal transduction can manifest as hematological disorders, e.g., leukemia, severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) and autoimmune disease states. While regulatory JAK3 phosphosites have been well studied, here a functional proteomics approach coupling a JAK3 autokinase assay to mass spectrometry revealed ten previously unreported autophosphorylation sites (Y105, Y190, Y238, Y399, Y633, Y637, Y738, Y762, Y824, and Y841). Of interest, Y841 was determined to be evolutionarily conserved across multiple species and JAK family members, suggesting a broader role for this residue. Phospho-substitution mutants confirmed that Y841 is also required for STAT5 tyrosine phosphorylation. The homologous JAK1 residue Y894 elicited a similar response to mutagenesis, indicating the shared importance for this site in JAK family members. Phospho-specific Y841-JAK3 antibodies recognized activated kinase from various T-cell lines and transforming JAK3 mutants. Computational biophysics analysis linked Y841 phosphorylation to enhanced JAK3 JH1 domain stability across pH environments, as well as to facilitated complementary electrostatic JH1 dimer formation. Interestingly, Y841 is not limited to tyrosine kinases, suggesting it represents a conserved ubiquitous enzymatic function that may hold therapeutic potential across multiple kinase families.
abstract_zh: Janus酪氨酸激酶3（JAK3）主要在免疫细胞中表达，是共同γ链（gammac）细胞因子家族信号传导所必需的。JAK3信号转导异常可表现为血液系统疾病，例如白血病、严重联合免疫缺陷（SCID）和自身免疫性疾病状态。虽然调控性JAK3磷酸化位点已被广泛研究，但本研究采用功能蛋白质组学方法，将JAK3自激酶测定与质谱联用，揭示了十个此前未报道的自磷酸化位点（Y105、Y190、Y238、Y399、Y633、Y637、Y738、Y762、Y824和Y841）。值得注意的是，Y841被确定在多个物种和JAK家族成员中具有进化保守性，表明该残基具有更广泛的作用。磷酸化替代突变体证实Y841也是STAT5酪氨酸磷酸化所必需的。同源的JAK1残基Y894对诱变产生类似反应，表明该位点在JAK家族成员中具有共同的重要性。磷酸化特异性Y841-JAK3抗体可识别来自各种T细胞系和转化型JAK3突变体的活化激酶。计算生物物理学分析将Y841磷酸化与JAK3 JH1结构域在不同pH环境下的稳定性增强，以及促进互补静电JH1二聚体形成联系起来。有趣的是，Y841不仅限于酪氨酸激酶，表明它代表一种保守的普遍酶学功能，可能在多个激酶家族中具有治疗潜力。
